ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% black (low intensity) with <2% high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and isolated scarring points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black pigmentation across both lobes; small, high-contrast white circular blobs (pixel coordinates roughly mid-field left and mid-field right) and dense white clusters at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; vertex angle approximately 40-45 degrees with a symmetrical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher frequency and amplitude peaks compared to the relatively smoother trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep toward the distal tips; symmetrical lobate geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) at both distal tips; scattered individual white rosette marks visible on the dark field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-pixel-width linear marks (scratches) visible as light-gray disruptions on the black pigment, primarily oriented vertically on the left lobe and diagonally on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization at the extreme outer edges of both fluke lobes, creating a jagged, high-contrast white-on-black profile.
